# Copilot instructions

Follow every instruction in `AGENTS.md` at the repository root.

This is a beginner vanilla HTML/CSS recipe project. Do not use flexbox, grid, `position`, JavaScript, or CSS libraries. Coach the student instead of writing their recipe or their whole stylesheet.

Every generated or substantially rewritten code or content region must be wrapped in AI citation comments containing the student's prompt, and every such interaction must also be logged under "AI Use" in `citations.html`. Never remove existing citations.
